programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Murder 101
programme.desc: Murder mystery starring Dick Van Dyke (ʻChitty Chitty Bang Bangʼ) as an absent-minded and brilliant criminology professor, and his son Barry Van Dyke as an ex cop turned private investigator. programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Zalgiris Kaunas - AS Monaco
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: The Rise of Black Wolf
programme.desc: In Yellowstone National Park, several wolf packs reside and compete for territory and pack leadership. A successful wolf pack survives by keeping order, respecting the hierarchy and obeying the leaders. But among these packs, a dark wolf with an unusual approach appears. Sometimes a loner, often a Casanova, eventually a leader- his surprising recipe for success broadens the definition of "normal" wolf behavior.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: The highest mountains on Earth are home to snow leopards, golden eagles, mountain goats, barnacle goslings and gelada monkeys. But only the toughest can endure the extreme weather, scarce food supplies and limited oxygen on these peaks. Showcasing never-before-filmed animal behaviour using new technology to capture fresh angles and scales, Hostile Planet provides unique access to one of the most extreme environments on the planet.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Delve beneath the surface of the largest habitat on Earth - our oceans - to uncover a world of extraordinary extremes from crushing depths to stormy coasts and vast blue deserts to crowded reefs. Oceans are dynamic environments where animals must adapt to life of constant change. Discover how seals fend off sharks; how turtles risk their lives to create their next generation; and how ingenious orca fight to survive in the face of ever-increasing competition.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Step inside the most frigid habitat known to Earth - the poles. Here, the planet's ultimate survivalists include whale-hunting polar bears, leopard-seal dodging penguins and a pack of Arctic wolves that bring down a pair of musk oxen. Polar species have evolved bodies and behaviours that help them combat the intense hostility of their habitats. But now, their world is changing so fast - literally breaking apart under their feet - and their resilience will be tested beyond the extreme.

programme.title: Hostile Planet

As jungle seasons become more unpredictable only the toughest animals will triumph.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise

Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise

Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The polar bear is the world's largest land predator-but it's born blind and deaf. How does a helpless cub become a successful killer? Built for the Kill: Polar Bear exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail. The cub spends about three years at its mother's side, learning to navigate the harsh Arctic environment.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The killer whale is the world's biggest dolphin-32 feet long and up to six tons heavy. Smart, sophisticated, and social, they live in groups and hunt cooperatively. But it's no natural born killer. Calves spend several years at their mother's side, learning how to hunt some of the smallest-and biggest-animals in the sea. Built for the Kill: Killer Whale exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Shark vs Whale
programme.desc: A routine drone survey turns deadly when Ryan Johnson, a marine biologist based in South Africa, films a humpback whale being attacked and strategically drowned by a Great white shark. This is a total perspective shift on a creature he's spent his life studying. To make sense of this event, Ryan follows Humpback whales on their migration, mapping their weak spots. He also takes a new look at Great White sharks. How do they become whale killers?

programme.title: Shark vs Predator
programme.desc: Rare and remarkable instances of predation on sharks by a variety of species, capture by both daring photographers and unlikely bystanders, have given us new insight as to how the primacy of an apex predator can be challenged. We will analyze this growing body of footage with the aid of experts in the field, shedding light on how and why these events occur. Whether with talons, tentacles, or teeth, animals are hunting sharks all over the world.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Cosmo and Wanda grant a wish to make Hazel's potato project work for the Science Fair, they rewrite the rules of science for the whole universe! When the physical world goes haywire as a result, they can't undo it because not even their magic is not working correctly! And Sci, the Science Fairy, refuses to help Hazel because he does not approve of her shortcut. Hazel must learn the real science behind her potato project to power up Cosmo and Wanda's wands and set the universe right again. // After watching a detective TV show with her dad, Hazel wishes she could solve a mystery like a genuine gumshoe. At first, she is wrapped up in the thrill of solving a mystery, but things get real when the landlord goes missing. Everyone is a suspect - kids at school, the strange new neighbors, and even Cosmo and Wanda! Things intensify when Hazel suspects her family is the next target. In a dramatic climax at dinner at her neighbors', Hazel unveils the truth. Is it foul play? Or is it just her imagination?

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father's from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father; in which Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down. His friendship is put to the test, as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. programme.title: English Football League Championship
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Brave ragazze
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Serena Rossi, Ilenia Pastorelli e Silvia D’Amico nella commedia diretta da Michela Andreozzi. Quattro ragazze di Gaeta si travestono da uomini per rapinare una banca.

programme.title: Le amiche della sposa
programme.desc: Commedia di successo di Paul Feig con Kristen Wiig e Melissa McCarthy. Annie, damigella d'onore alle nozze della migliore amica Lilian, deve arginare le mosse astute delle altre ragazze.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Gli anni belli
programme.desc: Maria Grazia Cucinotta e Ninni Bruschetta in una commedia ambientata negli anni 90. Costretta a passare le vacanze nel solito campeggio, la ribelle Elena vivra' un'estate indimenticabile.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il matrimonio di Pasquali
programme.desc: 29esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. A Pineta, Massimo deve vedersela con i bimbi, nel frattempo Pasquali è alle prese con il suo matrimonio in Calabria.

programme.title: Benvenuti in casa Esposito
programme.desc: Prodotta da Alessandro Siani, commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Giovanni Esposito e Antonia Truppo, ispirata al libro di Pino Imperatore. Alla morte di un boss camorrista, il figlio, incapace di seguirne le orme, si cimenta in goffi tentativi di riscossione del pizzo.

programme.title: Para Sa Hopeless Romantic
programme.desc: A student writer struggles to find a happy ending for her romantic story when her own real life romance falls apart.

programme.title: Penduko
programme.desc: A 20 year-old wimp that was raised in the U.S. will go on a journey in the Philippines after his Father died to search his mother only to discover a curse and evil forces destroying the town.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: It follows the story of a former cartel assassin named Lily who fakes her own death after an unfulfilled mission that earns the wrath of her organization. She then goes to a distant province where she completely transforms her life.

programme.title: More Than Blue
programme.desc: The film centers on a terminally ill man who sets up his best friend, whom he has loved since high school, so that she will not be lonely after he passes away.

programme.title: Gandarrapiddo: The Revengers Squad
programme.desc: A story about Gandarra, Rapiddo, and Kweenie, who are all trying to attain and protect what is most precious to them. Family is the only thing that binds them, but as they stick to their separate missions, dark secrets arise and threaten to destroy everything they hold dear.

programme.title: When Love Begins
programme.desc: Benedicto \"Ben\" Caballero is an environmentalist who disapproves of deforestation for villages in mountainous regions in the country.He is more concerned of the environment than that of getting along with his siblings.It is revealed that he was a former lawyer and that he quit because of a matter between right or wrong,and not about winning or losing.He focuses on nature-for him,it's all about saving the planet.

programme.title: Kahit Ayaw Mo Na
programme.desc: It follows Joey who is a fashion designer, Mikee who is a vlogger and Ally who is an aspiring composer. What seemed to be an ordinary trip to Samar turned out to be more than they presume.

programme.title: Double Barrel
programme.desc: A young couple who are so poor that they have to work as hired killers.

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).
